name: ztpf_native_persona_and_house_rules
why: Two SHIPPED read paths had never been driven by any tier: the 8.0 native
persona read (`/api/3/assistant_personas`) and the learned-house-rules read
(`/api/3/assistant_skills`). Every offline row fell back to the legacy
`/api/3/keys`, and nothing anywhere loaded a skill.
That gap is invisible to every other grader by construction: both persona
substrates resolve the SAME persona, so the tools, the prose and the
verdicts are identical whichever one answered. Only the read list can tell
them apart, which is what the `reads` expectation is for -- and why it
asserts `/api/3/keys` was NOT reached. Without that half, a module read
that returned nothing would still pass, rescued by the fallback.
The house rules are the second half. This bundle's rules are scoped to
`ztpf_devices` and one of them names the real playbook by name, so a turn
that loaded them can reach `run_playbook` without a discovery detour --
but discovery is still allowed, because a model that verifies a name it
was told is behaving BETTER, not worse (see ztpf_run_pending_steps, where
refusing to invent a name was the correct outcome).
`both_called_in_order` rather than `called_before`: the point of this arc
is that the playbook RAN. `called_before` passes when the second call never
happened, which graded a run-nothing arc green once already.
